function.description: Returns the authenticated user's handle, email, all the plans the user belongs to (and the ID for each plan) and their seats on those plans. code_layers_enabled indicates whether the user has access to Code Layers in Design on any plan; each plan also includes code_layers_enabled for files owned by that plan. You MUST use this tool if you are experiencing file access/permission issues or are being rate limited by the Figma MCP to help debug the issue.
